Dialogs.Dialog: Anegasaki
Hey... have you ever seen that doughnut truck around？
Can't say I have... Why do you ask？
A friend told me she bought some the other day, and they were super delicious!
Aren't there plenty of other tasty doughnut places？
True, but... she insisted they'd be totally my style!
To ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s liking？ Now I'm curious...
I am too! But since it's a food truck, I haven't been able to find it at all.
Then maybe ● should try looking for it？
Really？ Thank you! If you find it, let's eat some together, okay♪
(Wait, is that the doughnut truck she mentioned？)
(All right, I'll buy some for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲! I brought what I promised!
Anegasaki
What you promised... I wonder what it is？
Here it is—doughnuts!
Whoa♪ You remembered？ I'm so happy!
I picked a random mix, so eat whichever you like.
Yay! Don't mind if I do, then♪
● tried picking ones ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ might like... How are they？
...Delicious! No worries. Looks like you know my taste really well, ▼
That's a relief.
Such nice weather... Now I'm getting hungry.
Anegasaki
Geez, what's with that？ ...Oh right! A friend said she found a tasty crepe place.
A new shop？
Apparently they only open in spring with a food truck, moving all around town.
Sounds pretty whimsical...
Ah, I'd really love to try their crepes too...
Then maybe ● should look for it too.
(Wait, is that the crepe truck she mentioned？)
(All right, I'll call ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ over.)
Ah, there she is.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲! You said you found the crepe truck, so I rushed right over.
Look, that's the crepe truck from the rumors.
Whoa, it really is! It's just like I imagined!
Man, ● can't resist this smell.
Hehe... I guess that counts as dumplings over flowers？
Anyway, let's hurry up and buy some.
Yeah. Now I'm starting to get hungry too♪
Ugh... It's so muggy.
Anegasaki
Hey now, snap out of it, or you'll get lazier, okay？
I really want something cold to eat...
True... Oh! Speaking of cold treats, I heard a gelato place is around... Know it？
I haven't heard. Wonder where it is？
It's a mobile truck, so no one knows when or where it'll be. That kind of thing just makes you even more curious, doesn't it？
Yeah. ●'m getting curious, too.
Then I'll text you if I spot it. Let's eat together♪
Got it. ●'ll let you know if I spot it, too.
(Wait, is that the gelato truck everyone's talking about？)
(All right, I'll call ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. You found the gelato truck？
Yup. Look, right there.
It's even cuter than I imagined. It just makes me so happy.
Better not get too excited and eat too much, though.
Hey, I'm only having one! Though I'd love it if you let me try some of yours？
Haha, you got it.
Anegasaki
A while back, my friends and I talked about autumn foods. But everyone had different favorites. There really are so many!
Sounds like fun.
Yeah. Say, what comes to mind when you think of autumn foods？
●'d say... saury, matsutake, persimmons, chestnuts...
Yes, exactly! For me, chestnuts were what came to mind.
Chestnuts are great. Come to think of it, I heard there's a roasted chestnut truck around lately.
Oh, I've heard of that! Though no one knows when or where it shows up.
Hmm, maybe I'll try looking for it...
(Wait, is that the roasted chestnut truck everyone's talking about？)
(All right, I'll buy some for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.)
Sorry to call you out so suddenly.
Anegasaki
Not at all, I don't mind one bit.
There was something I wanted to give ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, so I rushed right over.
For me？ I wonder what it is...
Here.
Ah... Roasted chestnuts!▼
An autumn treat. I thought we could eat them together.
I'm so happy you remembered. As a reward, maybe I should feed you one... Hehe.▼
(So glad I brought them!)
Anegasaki
When you were a kid... did anyone ever roast sweet potatoes for you over a bonfire？
Ah, yeah, I might have done something like that.
The potato wrapped in foil was so hot you'd almost burn yourself. But it was sweet and fragrant... so good.
Uh-huh.
You don't really see that kind of thing anymore... In fact, I haven't heard the sweet potato truck calling out lately...
Yeah, now that you mention it... They must be around somewhere, though.
Are they really, I wonder？ Ah... now I'm really craving roasted sweet potato.
●'m craving some too. Maybe I'll buy one next time I see the truck.
Then get some for me too, okay？ Heheh♪
(Oh, is that the sweet potato vendor we talked about？)
(All right, I'll buy some for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I got that thing we were talking about.
Anegasaki
What thing？
A baked sweet potato from the vendor! Here you go.
Wow... thank you!
I hope it tastes like you remember from childhood.
Well, only one way to find out!
Yeah, let's dig right in...
Anegasaki
Hey, do you believe in UFOs？
Well... I guess you can't completely rule them out. That's the thing with UFOs.
I see. Then if I told you I saw a UFO, would you believe me？
You saw one!?
No. Actually, a friend of mine said she saw one. She even took a picture! She said, "They've been around a lot lately, so anyone can snap a photo"...
Huh... If you can really see them, ● would kind of like to see one too.
Me too. Let's report back if either of us spots one!
(A UFO, huh...)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, have you seen any UFOs since then？
Anegasaki
No, not at all.
Heh, I see...
What's with that puffed-up chest？ Don't tell me... did you actually see a UFO？
Actually, yeah! Look, here's the photographic evidence.
No way, really？ ...Wait, what!? Something's actually in this!
See？ That's the UFO ● saw.
Amazing! Can I make a copy of this？ I have to show my friend!
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, do you know about Towassie？
Anegasaki
Towassie？ Um... you mean that giant creature rumored to live in Lake Towano, right？
Oh, so you do know about it？ ● only heard about it recently.
I think it's pretty famous around here. A lot of people say they've seen it.
Do you believe that story, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Hmm, I'd like to believe it, but when you think about why no one has definitive footage... well, you know？
Yeah, true.
If you brought me a photo, I might just believe you... fufu♪
(Towassie... Now I'm curious.)
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Anegasaki
What is it？ You sound so serious all of a sudden.
Actually, I got an amazing photo!
Fufu, you're so excited. It must be a really amazing photo, huh？
It's a huge scoop! Here, can you tell what this is？
...Wait, could this be!?
Yep, Towassie! ● saw it with my own two eyes!
Wow, amazing! So Towassie really is real! I totally believe it now!
(I'm glad it made her happy.)
Anegasaki
It's almost time for midterms, huh？
It's almost time for finals, huh？
You seem pretty relaxed, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Not really, but I set a goal and got ready a bit, I guess？ Why don't you set one too？
I see. Well, ●...
Aim for 1st in the grade
Aim for top 10 in the grade
Aim for top 100 in the grade
Anegasaki
Midterms are creeping up. Have you been preparing？
Finals are creeping up. Have you been preparing？
Well, bit by bit, I guess...
Hmm？ In that case, why not tell me what rank you're shooting for？
Well, my goal is...
Aim for 1st in the grade
Aim for top 10 in the grade
Aim for top 100 in the grade
Anegasaki
Midterms are finally here. Have you been studying hard？
Finals are finally here. Have you been studying hard？
It's going well, I guess.
You study much better with a goal. Why not declare one right now？
A goal, huh... In that case...
Aim for 1st in the grade
Aim for top 10 in the grade
Aim for top 100 in the grade
Anegasaki
Wait, you don't have to push yourself, you know？
I was being pretty serious, though...
Anegasaki
Hehe... Are you sure you want to make a claim like that？
Yeah, a man keeps his word.
Anegasaki
You sure are making a bold claim...
A goal's gotta be high, right？
Anegasaki
Whoa... You're actually pretty pumped up, huh？
You bet.
Anegasaki
Really？ There's no taking it back, you know.
I've got this!
Anegasaki
That's great! I'll be cheering for you, too♪
Thanks.
Anegasaki
I see. I'll be rooting for you.
Yeah.
Anegasaki
Wouldn't that be pretty easy for you？
That's not the case.
Anegasaki
Yeah, I know you can do it.
Hearing you say that really gives me a boost.
Anegasaki
Then let's both do our best, okay？
Yeah.
Anegasaki
Now that our goals are set, shall we give it our best？
You got it!
Anegasaki
All right, let's do our best together.
Okay!
Man, I'm beat...
Anegasaki
That's it for today's tests. How'd it go？
Phew. Somehow made it through.
Anegasaki
Good job today. Did your tests go smoothly？
All right, all done.
Anegasaki
Good work today. Did all your studying pay off？
Yeah, it was perfect!
Felt pretty good about it.
Yeah... not bad, I think.
Anegasaki
More tests tomorrow, too. Let's hang in there, okay？
Anegasaki
Let's both do our best so we keep our groove tomorrow.
Anegasaki
Let's do our best tomorrow, so we're always at our peak♪
Anegasaki
Well, whatever happens, it's finally over! Good job.
Anegasaki
Mmm, we're both free at last! Good job, you.
Anegasaki
Good job this whole week. You worked so hard, didn't you？ There, there.▼
Exam results are posted... I wonder how I did.
Whoa! My name's in first place!
Anegasaki
Incredible, I'm so proud! I've gotta snap a picture.
Hey, that's embarrassing...
Huh？ Ah, I suppose. Anyway, congratulations!
...First place! This isn't a dream, right!?
Anegasaki
I can't believe it... Guess I shouldn't say that, though, huh？
Nah, even I can hardly believe it.
Still, it's real! Congratulations!
Yes! First place!
Anegasaki
What!? You actually took first place...？
Guess I can do it if I try, ●...
You put in so much effort, didn't you？ Good job!
Yes, made the top ten!
Anegasaki
Wow, congratulations! You worked so hard, after all.
Yeah, all that effort paid off.
Actually reaching your goal... that's really impressive.
Thank goodness, I reached my goal.
Anegasaki
Ah, you made the top ten？ Congratulations.
Okay, thanks.
You did great! Aiming even higher next time？
All right! Top ten goal cleared!
Anegasaki
That's wonderful, congratulations!
I really put my all into studying for this one.
Your girlfriend's so proud! Having such a wonderful boyfriend and all.▼
Phew... At least I made it into the top 100.
Anegasaki
Good for you!
Yeah, this is the least I should be able to do.
Then next time, you'll have to aim even higher!
Top 100... I made it. What a relief.
Anegasaki
For now, congrats on hitting your goal!
Yeah.
Now then, what rank are you aiming for next？
Goal reached... That's a relief.
Anegasaki
Oh dear, look at that relieved face. Were you cutting it that close？
Come on, that's not it...
I believed you'd be fine all along.
Figures... Guess 1st place was too much to ask...
Anegasaki
Maybe that goal was a bit too high？
You think so, too？
Working hard for first place will never go to waste! Let's try again, okay？
1st place... Yeah right, no way...
Anegasaki
Aww... That's too bad.
Maybe that was too reckless of a goal？
Maybe it's better to work your way up step by step...
Saying first place was aiming a bit too high, huh...
Anegasaki
And you worked so hard, too...
Well, it just means everyone besides ● was working hard, too.
That's true. I really like that humble side of you, though▼
Ugh... Didn't make it...
Anegasaki
That's too bad... And here I thought top 10 was within your reach.
Sorry I let you down...
No need to apologize, okay？ You're doing this for you, not for me, right？
Top 10... Top 10... Didn't make it, huh...
Anegasaki
Didn't reach your goal, huh...
Man, that's frustrating.
If you're that frustrated, I bet you'll make it next time, right？
No good... Not even in the top 10...
Anegasaki
Hey now, don't look so down!
Really...？
Just do your best next time! Aiming high in the first place was so cool... right？
Yikes... Didn't even make the top 100...
Anegasaki
Hmm... I wonder what went wrong？
I'm so pathetic...
It's not like you completely bombed... I'm sure you'll get it next time.
Whoa... You've got to be kidding me...？
Anegasaki
Huh...？ You didn't make the top 100 after all？
Looks like it...
Guess that means you still need a little more training？
Seriously...？ Not even in the top 100...
Anegasaki
Ah... Well, things like this happen sometimes.
And here I thought I had a pretty good shot...
We'll just have to do some special training to bounce back on the next test, okay？
Anegasaki
It was tough, but that's really the end of it all! Good job, you worked hard.
Yeah, you worked hard too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Anegasaki
Now we can go on dates with a clear mind♪
Yeah. Let's make the most of it!
Anegasaki
Now that exams are over, summer break is right around the corner. What should we do？
Go on dates with you, obviously, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
Anegasaki
Exams are done, but the year's almost over too, you know？ We'd better plan out winter break soon♪
Yeah. Let's spend lots of time together.
Anegasaki
Hey, hey, have you heard this rumor？
Hm, what rumor？
It's about... "The Ghost of Towano Castle."
A ghost...？ Like a ghost story or something？
Yep! Lately, they say groaning sounds have been heard night after night at Towano Castle...!
You look excited, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... I know you like horror fiction, but local urban legends too？
Hehe. Well, I don't dislike them, you know？
Huh. Towano Castle... I mean, we could go if we wanted to, but...
That's it! Bingo!
Huh？ No way...
It might be a bit early for them, but the sooner the better! Let's go right now!
...Better？
I wonder if it's around here...
It's pretty big, after all... Want to walk around a bit？
Hmm... Wait, what？
Hm？ What's up？
Hey, did you just say something？
...Just asked if you wanted to walk around.
Not that... After that...
Yeah...
...Nope, said nothing.
Okay...
Wait... Could it really be...？
...Maybe we should go home.
Yeah... good idea. I'm starting to feel a little sick anyway...
(Man, that's seriously creepy...)
Anegasaki
Oh, hey! I wonder what ended up happening with that story.
Which story？
"The Ghost of Towano Castle"!
Oh, that...
Hearing that voice out of nowhere startled me, but... I'm still curious. Wanna go check it out again？
● don't mind, but...
Thanks! Shall we get going, then？
(Well, guess it's fine...)
I think this is around where we heard that voice.
...Pretty sure, yeah.
...I don't hear anything.
Yeah. Maybe it's gone already？
Aww. Hearing it was scary, sure, but... it feels kinda anticlimactic like this...
(The real truth was pretty silly anyway. Best to keep quiet and not let her down.)
Anegasaki
Oh, right! Hey, have you heard？
...Hmm？
"The Mansion's Dracula Legend"!
Dracula？ What kind of story is that？
You know that Western-style mansion in town？ There's a rumor about that place.
Supposedly, every single night, they hold mysterious rituals inside!
Mysterious rituals？ Like what？
If I knew that, it wouldn't be a mystery! You can hear creepy noises, apparently.
Hmm...
Aren't you curious？ I know you are, right？
...You want to go check it out, don't you.
Of course! Pretty please？
Alright, let's go take a look, then...
This place... sure has an eerie atmosphere...
Wanna turn back after all？
I'm fine. At this hour... the ritual probably hasn't started yet. If we could at least find some clue...
Can't really tell what's going on inside...
Mmm... I wonder if they'd just let us in through the front door.
Hard to even tell if anyone actually lives here...
I suppose...
...Wait, what？
Huh？ ●？ I didn't say anything, though.
Really？ But...
Ah...
See？ You hear it, right？
...What is this sound？
It's the ritual! There really is a mysterious ritual...!
No way...
Hey, I think I'm starting to get a little scared...
Yeah, let's go.
Yeah... Sorry for dragging you along with me...
(Is the rumor... actually true？)
Anegasaki
Hey... I wonder what happened with that story...
Which story？
"The Legend of Dracula's Mansion"!
Oh... that one.
I got scared before, but now I'm just dying to know.
Hmm...
Won't you come with me again？
(Well, why not...)
...Wonder if we'll hear the ritual sounds？
I wonder...
...Mmm, I don't hear anything.
...Yeah, me neither.
Maybe I misheard... Though I really thought I heard something...
...Well, that happens.
*sigh*... Oh well. Shall we go？
(I could tell her the truth... but I'll keep quiet for now.)
Anegasaki
Oh, right! Did you see the news？
The news？ What was on？
"Bigfoot in the Mountains"!
Didn't see it... Bigfoot's a cryptid, right？
That's the one! Apparently, they found Bigfoot's footprints in the mountains.
Just footprints？ So nobody actually saw Bigfoot itself.
Seems like it.
Isn't it just some prank？
A prank, huh... But hey, there's a reward if you find it, you know？
A reward？ Wow, that's pretty serious...
Right？ Hmm, wouldn't it be great if it just popped up right in front of us~？
(Bigfoot, huh...)
Anegasaki
Guess that's reality for you.
Eh？ What？
"Bigfoot in the Mountains."
Just like you said, it looks like it was just someone's prank.
Haha, of course...
Naturally, no reward either... Aww.
Were you really after that reward？
Not really, but... hoping "what if" doesn't cost a thing, right？
Well, that's true.
Too good to be true, I guess. Too bad.
(Guess I'll keep what ● saw to myself...)
Anegasaki
Hey, hey, have you heard this one？
What is it？
"The Ghost of the Valley"!
A ghost？ ...Never heard of it.
It's about the valley in Oku-Towano, actually.
Oh, a local ghost story？
Yep! The tragic, beautiful ghost of a woman who died with lingering regrets!
Huh, so she's a beauty, is she...？
A beauty...？ That's what caught your attention？ She's a ghost, you know！
Haha, well...
Jeez... But still, I'm really curious about this story.
(A ghost, huh...？)
Oh, right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Anegasaki
...Hmm？
You were talking about the Ghost of the Valley before, right？
Uh-huh.
Heard any new info since then？
Not a single thing. Maybe it was just a rumor after all.
Well, the thing is, I actually got an email like this...
An email？
...Well？ What do you think？
Wait... Could this be... an email from a ghost...？ ...No way, right？
It's probably just a prank, but pretty crazy, right？
You didn't set this up yourself, did you？
No, no！ It really came from someone else.
Huh... Then what does this mean...？
(She's really overthinking it. Well, at least she found it entertaining...)
Anegasaki
Hey, remember when we went to the amusement park together the other day？
Yeah.
I think I dropped something while we were there.
Huh？ What did you lose？
A little drawstring pouch. It was my favorite, too...
Oh... Did you ask the park's lost and found？
Um... not yet.
Why not？ Someone might have turned it in.
Yeah, but...
...Hmm？
'The Mascot Ghost of the Amusement Park'！
...What's that？
Well, there's a rumor... that a ghost in a mascot suit picks up lost items after the park closes.
That's a weird ghost.
And if that ghost picks up your stuff, you'll be cursed unless you get it back in person！
...So that's why you haven't reported it.
Yeah. I was just a little curious.
(An amusement park ghost, huh...？)
Anegasaki
Well... here we are.
Naturally, it's closed.
Think they'd let us in？
Hmm, well, let's at least try asking.
Yeah...
Phew, what a relief. I'm so glad they let us in.
All right. Let's search before it gets too late！
We looked everywhere, but still...
It's pretty big, too... And it's getting late. What should we do？
Hmm...... Ah!
What？
Look... A ghost？
Eh！？
Mascot
U-Um, well...
Hey, the park's been closed for a while now. What are you two doing？
Eh？
A drawstring pouch... Ah, here it is, here it is.
Really？ That's great, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Thank you.
No, sorry to make you come all the way here. Changing was a hassle, so I just did my rounds like this... Didn't think it'd become a rumor.
Guess I'd better stop before I get chewed out. Anyway, you two head on home now.
...Glad you were able to find it.
Yeah, I'm glad. And now I won't be cursed, either!
Haha, were you actually believing that？
Hehe, no I wasn't!
(Well... that takes care of that, then.)
Anegasaki
We're here... Hey, do you think they'll let us in？
We can't just barge in... Let's look for security and ask them.
No one's around, huh... Guess we'll have to give up for today.
Yeah... Nothing we can do, I guess.
Anegasaki
Well... here we are.
A ghost might not have picked it up anyway. Let's check the info desk to see if it got turned in.
All right~
Attendant
A drawstring pouch... No, nothing has been turned in. I'm so sorry.
I see. Thank you anyway.
No luck, huh... Guess we should give up for today.
Mm, nothing we can do.
